subject: Private Way Parking Enforcement
overview: City officials hosted an informational public meeting to clarify parking rules, police enforcement limitations, and towing procedures for private ways in Medford ahead of the Green Line extension opening.

items.title: Welcome and Meeting Overview
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn opened the public meeting to discuss parking rules and enforcement options for residents living on private ways ahead of the Green Line extension opening.

items.title: Presentation on Private Way Parking Rules and Police Authority
items.summary: City officials presented state law guidelines on private ways, explaining that police can only enforce seven specific public safety violations while non-safety parking restrictions require private way owners to contract with towing companies.

items.title: Public Question and Answer Session
items.summary: Staff answered resident inquiries regarding private towing procedures, 48-hour abandoned vehicle rules, converting private ways into public streets, and neighborhood-specific concerns near Tufts University and Wright's Pond.
